visibility_definitions.manufacturer: Verified assigned manufacturer users and platform administrators
visibility_definitions.authenticated: Any authenticated platform user allowed by product/content policy
visibility_definitions.public: Unauthenticated public access after publication approval

governance.propose: Platform content stewards, product/Academy editors, and verified manufacturer users may propose.
governance.approve_categories_and_facets: Platform Administrator or designated taxonomy steward under existing organization administration.
governance.approve_aliases: Taxonomy steward; aliases cannot change canonical keys.
governance.manufacturer_suggestions: Submitted as suggestions, never direct taxonomy writes; owner/brand relationship must be verified separately.
governance.deprecation: Set inactive/deprecated in a new taxonomy version and require replacement_key where a successor exists.
governance.historical_preservation: Do not rewrite historical product assignments; retain assigned node/version and resolve current labels through replacement mapping.
governance.publication: Approve immutable version, generate versioned JSON projection/cache, then point consumers to that release.
governance.ai_refresh: Refresh taxonomy-aware metadata and embeddings after a published release; preserve source/version metadata.
governance.rollback: Republish the last approved immutable version and regenerate the prior projection.
governance.audit: Record proposer, approver, rationale, source evidence, version, and timestamp for each change.

mapping_policy.verified_manufacturer: UNKNOWN for every V1 mapping because brand_catalog.manufacturer_id is null for all mapped products; recorded manufacturer text is evidence only.
mapping_policy.confidence: HIGH when description identifies the product form; MEDIUM when category is reliable but form is not explicit; LOW/manual review when a requested facet lacks direct evidence.
